learning_outcomes.text: Identify the main tools for transmitting and receiving information in an IoT system.
Acquire basic knowledge of electromagnetic wireless devices and the main functionalities and tools to design IoT systems.

syllabus_topics: Basic knowledge on guided and wireless EM waves
Review of wire and planar antennas
Review of main parameters of transmitting and receiving antennas
Systems for Radio-Frequency IDentification (RFID): main aspects, applications in LF, HF and UHF bands, review of tags and readers
Main IoT technologies: Bluetooth, WiFi, Zig-Bee, Z-Wave, UWB
Wireless power transfer and energy harvesting
Lab experiences: design of dipolar and planar antennas by using Matlab toolbox
Programming of a simple IoT system

assessment_methods.method: Reports on single and group activities

assessment_rules: Students are required to deliver reports on the (single and group) activities carried out, which constitutes 70% of the grade. A final oral discussion is also planned, covering the topics presented during the course and the laboratory activities; this accounts for the remaining 30% of the final grade. The exam type is oral exam, graded as Voto Finale.
bibliography: Ulaby, Electromagnetics For Engineers, Pearson College Div.
Balanis, Antenna Theory: Analysis and Design, Wiley.
Hall, Antennas and Propagation for Body-Centric Wireless Communications, Artech House
degree: Laurea in Ingegneria Elettronica E Biomedica (Electronics And Biomedical Engineering), classe L-8 Classe delle lauree in Ingegneria dell'informazione
